structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a 10-day-old, already-migrated pump.fun token called "MrBeast". Its description is "Fees to @mrbeast", the usual "creator fees routed to a celebrity" gimmick. Its GeckoTerminal X handle points to the real @MrBeast account, which has no connection to it. In the last hour it jumped roughly 8–12x, from a dead ~$5–10k market cap to about $95–105k. That hour had about $95–105k of volume and ~388 unique buyers, and the last 5 minutes are down about 20% from the top. I found no news, X post or catalyst tied to this contract. The GMGN wallet data looks heavily manufactured: 325 bundler wallets, a 79% bot/degen rate and 438 fresh wallets. The creator is a serial deployer with 518 launches, and the linked X account has 3,967 launches.

narrative.description: MrBeast is a permanent memecoin theme with dozens of fake 'official' coins. MrBeast and his team keep publicly denying any coin. One site claims an 'official launch' on Sept 27, 2026, but it looks like a scam site. I found no real, current MrBeast crypto event.
narrative.why_spreading: No organic catalyst found. The move looks like a revival pump of a dormant token driven by bundlers and bots, possibly leaning on celebrity name-search traffic.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 325 bundler wallets, a 0.79 bot/degen rate, 438 fresh wallets and 29% held by top bundler traders. The creator has launched 518 tokens and the linked X account 3,967. The creator wallet is closed. The image is duplicated 5 times. A 10-day-dead token suddenly doing 3.4x its market cap in hourly volume, with no social trace, fits a coordinated revival pump.
